verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency is a fair question for a subscription SaaS like Shortcut, so the axis applies. The evidence never says whether any plan has a minimum seat count or requires annual billing. The 'Free forever' and '14 day full access, no credit card required' claims cover trial and free access, not seat minimums or billing commitments, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
